plugins.name: minz-ai
plugins.description: Read-only skills for Minz.ai: prepare customer calls, review the sales pipeline, plan your week and check MinzSpend expenses, using your Minz.ai workspace data.

skills.name: call-prep
skills.description: Prepare a brief before a call or meeting with a customer or prospect, using Minz.ai CRM data (company, contacts, open deals, deal history, recent activities, related tasks). Use when the user asks to prepare for, get ready for, or get background on a call, meeting or visit with a named company or person.

skills.name: expense-review
skills.description: Check MinzSpend expenses and expense reports in Minz.ai, including what the user submitted, what is waiting for approval, and what was approved, rejected or reimbursed in a period, with totals by status, category or vendor. Use when the user asks about their expenses, claims, reimbursements, settlements or spending in a period.

skills.name: my-week
skills.description: Summarize the user's schedule and workload from Minz.ai, including meetings, overdue and upcoming tasks, and recent sales activities, for today, this week or another short period. Use when the user asks what is on their plate, what is coming up, what is overdue, or to plan their day or week.

skills.name: pipeline-review
skills.description: Review the Minz.ai sales pipeline, including totals by stage, deals expected to close soon, and deals that look stalled or at risk, for a weekly sales meeting or a manager check-in. Use when the user asks about their pipeline, forecast, deals closing this month or quarter, or which deals need attention.
